description: Take a collection out of review once you are done - the clean exit that complements set_review. By default it REFUSES while any block-review thread is still open and names them, so a collection only leaves review once it reads clean; resolve those threads (set each block to done or approved), then call again. Pass force=true to end review anyway and abandon the open threads. The review record stays readable on the collection afterwards. Idempotent when the collection is already out of review.

collectionId.description: collection_id is the collection to take out of review.

force.description:
force ends review even while threads are still open. Default false: the call
 refuses and names the open threads, because minting a clean read is the
 whole point of ending review - the refusal is the useful part.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

name: end_review
title: Finish the review
